1) Lauren — please run a stage-health scrub for the 22 small opportunities and move any clearly stale records to Nurture (or reclassify as Proof-of-Life). Share a one-liner reason per change.
2) Rishi — can you validate the six large deals' close plans and update commit level (Commit/Best Case/Up) in the HubSpot link? If any need executive support, flag them.
3) Team — if you have >$50k ARR deals that have not had contract countersigned in the last 10 days, paste them in a reply (I will escalate).

I put the CSV export and the latest MA plan in the thread attachments. We'll do a 20-minute pulse Tuesday morning to lock numbers.

Thanks,
